title: Democrats Pick Three Cities for Their Big 2028 Party
summary:
Where do you throw a party for thousands of people? The Democratic Party is trying to figure that out! They need a city for their 2028 presidential convention, a huge event where they'll officially introduce their candidate for president. On Thursday, they narrowed the list to three cities: Boston, Denver, and Philadelphia.

The convention is scheduled for August 7-10, 2028. It's a chance for the party to rally its supporters and kick off the final push before the general election. The Republicans have already chosen Houston for their convention.

So why these three cities? All of them are in areas where Democrats usually do well. Boston is in Massachusetts, Denver is in Colorado, and Philadelphia is in Pennsylvania. Pennsylvania is extra interesting because it's a "battleground" state—sometimes it votes Democratic, sometimes Republican. In fact, President Trump won Pennsylvania in 2024. Hosting the convention there could help Democrats win it back.

Party leaders visited five cities earlier this year, but they didn't say why Atlanta and Chicago were cut. Chicago hosted the 2024 convention. The final decision will be made later this year.

Philadelphia last hosted the convention in 2016, Denver in 2008, and Boston in 2004. So all three cities have experience. Now it's a waiting game to see which one gets the big party!
why_it_matters: It shows how choosing one city can influence a presidential election and bring national attention to local places, which can affect issues that matter to families and schools.

background_read: The Democratic Party and the Republican Party are the two largest political parties in the United States.
Boston is the largest city in Massachusetts, Denver is the largest city in Colorado, and Philadelphia is the largest city in Pennsylvania (a state in the eastern United States).
Political parties hold national conventions every four years before the November presidential election, where they formally nominate their candidate and make speeches to the country.
